scope.question: Can the promoter-relevant L11MLP CLS write be captured by a low-rank causal subspace?
scope.primary_intervention: reciprocal target/control exchange restricted to a frozen L11MLP write subspace
scope.primary_endpoint: paired class-margin loss relative to full L11MLP exchange
scope.boundary: L11MLP was selected on these D10 cohorts before this assay. Development-to-confirmation basis transfer tests structural compression but is a post-hoc, cohort-reused follow-up, not a fresh independent confirmation or a biological mechanism.

cohort.reuse_status: both splits were previously scored in D10 for the individual-node atlas; no low-rank basis or projection outcome was previously computed

basis.fit_matrix: uncentered paired target-minus-control L11MLP CLS writes
basis.method: right singular vectors with deterministic sign canonicalization

inference.random_subspace_distribution: Gaussian QR in the full 768-dimensional residual space
inference.selection_rule: smallest rank in the frozen grid clearing every development gate and all 31 dimension-matched random subspaces
inference.confirmation_rule: same rank and basis must clear the unchanged effect, capture, accuracy, interval, and random-subspace gates
